links.targetTitle: BD planning — industry and companion-software selection (20 Aug 2026)

title: Banking's long tail is attractive precisely because software is becoming the product
content:
The session recorded a "long tail of community banks and insurers", "potentially well connected", with an established consultancy market — qualified immediately by "but it may be dominated by the big players only". Both PMF and companion-software candidates are marked unresolved.

The countervailing observation is the interesting one: "software / app support is becoming increasingly a large part of the value proposition of banks/insurers". If true, the addressable spend grows without the institutions consolidating, which is exactly the condition that sustains a long tail worth selling into.

The unresolved question is whether the consultancy channel into that tail exists or whether it terminates at a handful of large firms — which would break the channel strategy in this sector specifically.
description: The opportunity is a long tail of community banks and insurers, with the caveat that the consultancy market may be dominated by big players only.
